## Meter Reading

`value`, `unit`, `readAt`, `readByName`, `source` (manual / import / sensor), `note`. Append-only: **Record Meter Reading** is the single writer and refuses a cumulative reading lower than the previous. The ordered list and the `delta` live on the **Meter** card.

### Use

Embed it as the `readings` list on a Meter, or as a one-off observation on an inspection checklist item. `value` takes the catalog Quantity field with its minimum opened up, because a temperature gauge can read below zero while a part count cannot. `source` records where the number came from, so an imported or sensor reading can be told apart from one typed in by a technician.
